name: Mike Winters
tagline: Program Management · Project Management · Data & AI Operations
heroSummary: I build systems and teams that make complex operations easier to run. At Meta, I lead an 80+ person annotation team, the go-to pilot team for new and complex AI workflows, while supporting reporting for a wider 400+ person, 6-region operation.
about: Nearly 20 years in operations have shaped how I approach delivery, quality, and leadership development. At Meta, I lead an 80+ person annotation team and built and ramped annotation workflows across 9+ languages with engineering and product. I coach 12 workstream leads and developed central training resources and onboarding for new coordinators and leaders.

Earlier, I helped build Figure’s originations operations from pre-launch to $200M+ in monthly volume for my team. At Kikoff, I drove operational delivery for the Canada expansion and managed BPO relationships for a 120-person offsite team. I’m pursuing Program and Project Management roles, including outside tech.
